BiblicalUsage: Mighty appears once, and it is attached to the hand of God: "Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time" in 1 Peter 5:6. The word is the adjective behind power and strength, used here of God's hand alone.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse pairs the two things exactly right: God's hand is mighty, and mine is not, so humility under that hand is the only safe place to stand.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
